# Where to Watch Christmas in the Smokies


by Angel | November 5, 2026


Shelby Haygood's lived on her family's Smoky Mountain berry farm all her life. Now a looming retail expansion threatens to take it. With time running out before the property is seized, Shelby comes up with a plan: a Christmas concert headlined by her country music superstar ex.


*Christmas in the Smokies* is a small-town holiday romance with family, faith, and music at its center. As Christmas gets closer, the whole town has to decide what it's willing to fight for.


[Stream Christmas in the Smokies on Angel and settle in.](https://www.angel.com/watch/christmas-in-the-smokies)


#### A Farm Worth Fighting For


The story starts with a simple, relatable problem. The family's berry farm is the only life Shelby's ever known, and a retail expansion is closing in. When the deadline gets close, she has to get creative.


Shelby's answer is a Christmas concert, and a big one. Bringing in her country music superstar ex is a bold move, and it stirs up more than ticket sales. Old feelings, old questions, and a town full of opinions all come along with him.


Guild members have noticed how the story keeps you guessing.


"I love Christmas movies so I thought I totally knew what would happen... But NO! YOU SURPRISED ME!" — Christina B., Angel Guild


#### Faith, Family, and Community


As the holiday approaches, the town has to rediscover what matters most. *Christmas in the Smokies* leans into the power of family, faith, and neighbors who show up for each other. It's gentle, sincere, and easy to watch together.


That's a big reason it's found a loyal audience. Many viewers say it's a movie they can share with everyone in the house, from grandparents to kids.


Others point to the small-town heart of it all, with the kind of wisdom you might hear from a neighbor on the porch.


"One of the best Act 1 set up presentations in a rom-com ever. Then there are the pearls of wisdom coming from small town folk… I'll recommend this to family and friends." — @a.duncan6791, YouTube


#### Music, Romance, and Holiday Cheer


With a country music star and a Christmas concert at the center of the plot, music is a big part of the fun—and viewers have taken notice.


"A lot of wonderful Christmas music." — Rena L., Angel Guild


The romance adds warmth without getting in the way of the story. It's a Christmas movie that feels cozy, wholesome, and a little bit surprising.


#### Why Viewers Keep Coming Back


Some movies you watch once. Others become part of your holiday routine. Plenty of viewers say *Christmas in the Smokies* is one of those.


"This has become an annual tradition for our family to watch. We love it and the message." — @GWTX, YouTube


Another viewer shared the same love for it:


"My wife and I watch this movie every Christmas… Trust me, if you're looking for a feel good Christmas movie outside of the classics, then this is just the one for you." — sinskiman, IMDb


#### Watch *Christmas in the Smokies* on Angel


A woman, a berry farm, and a town that needs a little Christmas spirit. *Christmas in the Smokies* brings together romance, music, and a story about family, faith, and community. It's warm, wholesome, and made for sharing.
